top_findings.title: Overlapping Brasileirao files double-counted: standings/stats inflated ~2x
top_findings.evidence: soccer_mcp.py:85-105 loads Brasileirao_Matches.csv AND novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv both under competition 'Brasileirao' with no dedup (2019 has 380 rows in each = 760); standings(2019) -> Flamengo-RJ played=76 pts=180 vs correct 38/90.
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate overlapping seasons before aggregating standings/stats.
